questions.q: What two basics should you verify first, before diagnosing any specific refresh error?
options: That the gateway version is up to date, and that the report has a gateway selected at all
That the report has been viewed in the last 24 hours
That the user has a Premium license
That the semantic model has fewer than 100 rows
questions.explain: The official troubleshooting guidance starts with these two checks before anything else, since an outdated gateway or a missing gateway selection explains a large share of failures.

questions.q: What happens after a scheduled refresh fails four times in a row?
options: The semantic model is automatically deleted
Nothing happens — refresh attempts continue indefinitely
Power BI automatically disables the scheduled refresh
Power BI automatically doubles the refresh frequency
questions.explain: Four consecutive failures triggers an automatic disable. Re-enabling requires fixing the underlying issue and manually turning the schedule back on.

questions.q: What does a GatewayNotReachable error when setting credentials usually indicate?
options: The semantic model exceeded the size limit
An outdated gateway version — installing the latest version and retrying usually resolves it
The user's Power BI license expired
The data source no longer exists anywhere
questions.explain: This error is commonly the result of an outdated gateway. Installing the latest gateway version and trying again is the documented fix.

questions.q: What is the maximum scheduled-refresh duration on shared capacity, versus Premium capacity?
options: 30 minutes on both
Unlimited on both
5 hours on shared capacity, 2 hours on Premium
2 hours on shared capacity, 5 hours on Premium
questions.explain: Shared-capacity refreshes must complete within 2 hours; Premium capacity extends that to 5 hours (and the XMLA endpoint can bypass the limit entirely).

questions.q: Where would you look first to diagnose why a specific refresh attempt failed?
options: The app's audience settings
The workspace's contact list
Refresh history, which logs the status, duration, and error message for every attempt
The Power BI Desktop Home ribbon
questions.explain: Refresh history is the log of every refresh attempt with its outcome and error message — the natural starting point for diagnosing any specific failure.
